newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian transport workers pay rise rejected.
newsitem.headline: Australian transport workers pay rise rejected.

text.p: The Australian Industrial Relations Commission on Thursday rejected a claim for an 11 percent pay rise by the pwerful Transport Workers' Union.
The commission said it had rejected the union's call for an increase in award pay rates because its claim was not a special case -- as required under wage-fixing principles.
"Put simply we were told the position was all or nothing," the full bench of the commission said.
"For the reasons we have given above the answer cannot be all, accordingly it must be nothing," it said.
The union applied for a pay rise earlier this year, after a successful outcome for workers in New South Wales who received a 15 percent increase.
